PR: fix: cache full DNS response and handle TTL expiration in FindZoneByFqdn [closed; labels release-note, approved, lgtm, kind/feature, size/M, area/acme, dco-signoff: yes, ok-to-test, area/acme/dns01]
### Pull Request Motivation

Updated fqdnToZone cache to store the entire dns.Msg response instead of just the zone string, and also introduced a CachedEntry struct that includes the DNS response and its expiration time based on the SOA record's TTL. I've also modified FindZoneByFqdn to check for expired cache entries before returning cached results.
